positive.prompt: Where should this project walkthrough and its evidence be saved?
Create the human HTML reading view from our canonical Markdown specification.
Update our project status and log without duplicating the task plan.

negative.prompt: Break the approved specification into implementation tasks.

evals.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and request.md. Produce the requested reading view and update the resume point in the approved paths. Do not create directories. Identify any requested output without an approved destination and leave that decision open.
evals.expected_output: An HTML reading view derived from the existing requirements, a source hash, a concise status update and an explicit unresolved destination, without extra folders or competing requirements.
expectations: Creates the reading view in specs/ and identifies the exact source and its hash
Preserves the existing Markdown requirements as the authority instead of independently rewriting requirements
Keeps task scheduling in plans/build.md and links it from status
Does not create slides/ or another unapproved substitute destination
Reports the unresolved slide-deck request rather than silently dropping it
